header.title: Jobshout AI Agent Framework
header.subtitle: Specialist agents that do the job — and stop for your approval.
header.description: Open-source agent orchestration from TenthMatrix. Describe a job in plain English; the agent plans it, signs into your real tools, streams every step, and pauses before anything is sent, spent or deleted. Self-host it, or run it as a managed service.

intro.title: Agents that finish work, not chats that describe it
intro.body: Most AI tools give you text back. Jobshout gives you a completed job: a reply drafted in your mailbox, a pull request reviewed, a security report with reproduction steps, an SEO score with fix prompts, a researched brief with citations you can open. The agent does the work; you decide what ships.

items.title: A place to delegate
items.text: Brief an agent the way you would a colleague — one sentence is usually enough.

items.title: A team of specialists
items.text: Built-in agents each with their own tools, prompt and rules — Mail, Career, Research, Articles, Security, PR review, Images, SEO Analyst and more.

items.title: Real tool use
items.text: Agents sign into Gmail, GitHub, job boards and live sites, then click through them like a person would.

items.title: Supervised by design
items.text: Mark which tools need a human decision. Those calls pause the run until you approve or reject.

steps.title: One job, start to finish, in five moves

items.title: Describe the job
items.text: Type it in chat, or fill the short form the agent publishes. "Chase the two overdue invoices." "Review pull request 184." "Analyse this site for SEO."

items.title: The agent plans
items.text: It picks the tools it needs and asks for anything missing — a target URL, a repository, the sender to watch. It will not invent details it was not given.

items.title: It runs for real
items.text: Signed into your tools, one step at a time: search, open, read, cross-check, draft. Each step streams into the run as it happens.

items.title: It stops at the gate
items.text: Reach a gated tool and the run pauses mid-loop. State is saved; it resumes from that exact step when you approve — or takes your reason when you reject.

items.title: The result lands
items.text: A draft, report, brief or image arrives on your task board with artifacts and full step history. You review it, then send it yourself.

agents.title: Give each agent a job
agents.intro: Specialists ship with Jobshout. Each owns a lane, brings its own tools, and answers in the same chat behind the same approval gate. Agents are modular — a new specialist registers its prompt, tools and launch form without touching the platform.

items.title: Mail Agent
items.text: Watch the senders you care about, research the thread, and leave a reply draft. Nothing is sent until you approve.

items.title: Career Agent
items.text: Evaluate a job posting against your profile and return a clear fit assessment.

items.title: Research Agent
items.text: Return cited findings you can open — SLAs, competitor notes, source-checked briefs.

items.title: Article Writer
items.text: File a draft article on the board with structure and artifacts attached.

items.title: Security Tester
items.text: Scan an authorised target and hand back a report with reproduction steps.

items.title: PR Reviewer
items.text: Review a GitHub pull request and leave structured feedback for your team.

items.title: Image Generator
items.text: Make one picture and store it on the board — no unattended posting.

items.title: SEO Analyst
items.text: Crawl a URL for title, meta, headings, robots and sitemap health. Improve proposes fixes; Publish applies via WordPress, OpsAPI or a git PR — with approval.

items.title: Tasks, projects and sprints
items.text: Every run becomes a task you can see, sort and reassign, with its output and artifacts attached. Group them into projects and plan them into sprints.

items.title: Multi-agent workflows
items.text: Chain specialists into a dependency graph. Steps with no prerequisites run at the same time; dependent steps wait for their inputs.

items.title: Jobs that repeat
items.text: Put a job on a cron schedule — the Monday chase, the morning research brief, the weekly article. Results land on the board as usual.

items.title: Skills, plugins and MCP
items.text: Teach an agent your own tools. Jobshout speaks the Model Context Protocol, so any MCP server you run becomes discoverable tools.

items.title: Bring your own model
items.text: OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, or a model running locally through Ollama — no API key leaving the building when you self-host.

items.title: Cost and traces
items.text: Per-run tokens, latency and USD cost. Export OpenTelemetry traces to Langfuse when you want to go deeper.

deploy.title: Run it on your own infrastructure
deploy.body: A Go API, a Next.js interface, PostgreSQL and MinIO for object storage. Start the whole stack with docker compose up, or deploy the Kubernetes manifests. Your data and your prompts stay where you put them.

cta.title: Meet your first agent
cta.description: An AI teammate you can trust to get work done. Describe the job — a sentence is enough. Explore Jobshout on the product site, or talk to TenthMatrix about deploying the framework for your team.
